question: Which product category is growing the fastest? Give the category and its growth as a percentage.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH rev_2024 AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS rev FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.category), rev_2025 AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS rev FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.category) SELECT r2025.category, (r2025.rev - r2024.rev) * 100.0 / r2024.rev AS growth_pct FROM rev_2025 AS r2025 JOIN rev_2024 AS r2024 ON r2025.category = r2024.category ORDER BY growth_pct DESC LIMIT 1
